about: Synthetic multi-turn incident sessions for the v0.5 outcome-scored experiment. Turns declare the facts a correct answer needs and a mode (lookup | synthesis | action). They do NOT declare a route. 'family' is a descriptive tag used only to slice results; no arm reads it. Written by the repository author; see docs/preregistration-v0.5.md for threats to validity.

turns.text: What's the incident number?
Is checkout healthy right now?
What changed in the last checkout deploy?
turns.note: 'deploy' is a write verb in v0.4's regex, but this is a read.

turns.text: Validate its config against the baseline.
Why did checkout start failing after that release?
turns.note: Both config changes are candidate causes; the two runbooks explain the mechanisms.

turns.text: Roll back checkout to the previous build.
What's the error rate for payments?
And for search?
Same for auth.
Who owns search?
Page them.
Could you also page the checkout on-call?
turns.note: Polite phrasing that starts like a speculative question.

turns.text: Is search degraded?
Why is it so sluggish since this morning?
turns.note: No word in the turn overlaps the shard runbook.

turns.text: Did caching play a role?
Compare its current config with the baseline.
Post an update to the status page saying search is degraded.
Is checkout healthy, and who is on call for it?
Is checkout doing better or worse than before the deploy?
Show me the last rollback for checkout.
turns.note: No rollback has happened; the deploy history is the answer.

turns.text: Don't roll back yet; just tell me who approved the checkout deploy.
Make the previous checkout build live again.
turns.note: A rollback with no write verb from v0.4's regex.

turns.text: Who is the incident commander?
What severity is this incident?
When did it start?
Summarize the incident so far for a status-page draft.
turns.note: No service has been named in this session.

turns.text: Has auth's configuration drifted from baseline?
Could that drift be behind the checkout errors?
turns.note: Answering 'no' needs auth to be healthy and the note explaining the drift.

turns.text: Who owns auth?
Revoke the load-test rate limit on auth.
turns.note: No registered capability exists; nothing may execute.

turns.text: Run the smoke checks for payments.
Do the same for checkout.
Which of those checks failed?
Explain what the failed checks mean for the release.
Give me the current status of all four services.
Which ones were deployed today?
For checkout, compare current error rate with before the release.
What does the timeout runbook say?
Given everything so far, what is the most likely root cause, and what should we check next?
Draft the status-page update, but don't post it.
How is checkout doing?
What about the service that got reindexed this morning?
turns.note: Resolving the reference needs reasoning over the deploy history.

turns.text: Who approved that change?
Check whether the payments config matches its baseline.
Has payments had any deploys recently?
Could the payments library bump explain checkout's errors?
